input_image.description: The image to split into layers.
input_image.title: Image

max_layers.description: The most layers to return, not counting the base image. Higher values split the image more finely, and each layer is billed as an image.
max_layers.title: Max Layers

prompt.description: Optional. Name the elements to split out, such as "the cyclist, the scooter and the bakery sign". Leave blank to split out every main element.
prompt.title: Prompt

text_recognition.description: Read each text layer's wording, a similar font family and its color.
text_recognition.title: Text Recognition

watermark.description: Whether to add an 'AI generated' watermark.
watermark.title: Watermark
